title: Deploy Autopilot
subtitle: Configure an autonomous multi-agent analysis instance and pipe signals to your infrastructure.

step1.title: Select Target Asset
step1.desc: Which pair should the autonomous agents monitor?
step1.tip: Different assets require different topological models. The system will automatically switch the vector database index to match the selected asset.

step2.title: Agent Architecture Configuration
step2.desc: Select the computation depth for this autopilot.

nsed.name: Omni NSED Full
nsed.desc: Complete multi-agent pipeline including Dealer Adversarial and Risk Defense. Highest accuracy, utilizes maximum compute.

scalping.name: Sniper Scalping
scalping.desc: Optimized for speed. Bypasses deep L4 consensus to deliver structural signals in milliseconds. Ideal for HFT integration.

step3.title: Outbound Delivery Channels
step3.desc: Where should the agents stream their verdict once consensus is reached?

discord.name: Discord / Slack
discord.desc: Pipe rich-text analysis to your team's channel.

webhook.name: Custom HTTP Webhook
webhook.desc: Post pure JSON signals directly to your trading algorithm.

step4.title: System Ready for Launch
step4.desc: Your autonomous pilot is configured. It will continuously monitor structure variations.
